payload.purpose_context: This mission adds a manifest-runner-shaped muster adapter (src/adapters/spec-kitty-profile/) that statically validates Spec Kitty agent-profile YAML files against the upstream schema and muster-authored cross-profile lints (handoff-graph, doctrine-reference resolution, context-sources integrity, profile-id filename legality, projection-drift vs the agent_profiles_manifest), and ships three rubric documents under docs/rubric/ that this mission and the downstream M4 behavioral-axes mission both cite. It is deliberately not SpecAdapter-implementing (D1), following the memory-utilization adapter's manifest-runner shape.
payload.purpose_tldr: Static conformance adapter for Spec Kitty agent-profile YAML (*.agent.yaml) plus the rubric surface M4 depends on.

payload.wp_title: Projection drift, CLI wiring, fixtures/examples, real-CLI verification
